trial: Reinforced v2, Mark1 task1398879198 and Mark2 task1398871736
status: Hardware fit reports received for all five families. All spring leaves need intermediate thickness and root revision. PISCO retention and water-regulator fit rejected; meter and water-regulator caps need shaped bearing stock.

pisco.fit: Large gap and loose hardware; no useful retention. Derek is unsure about orientation and pairing.

asse.fit: Derek reports the hardware fit is in good shape; preserve the fitted cavity.
asse.spring: 2.6 mm leaves bend visibly at the corner/root rather than along the wall. Derek expects rapid wear; fatigue has not been measured.
asse.status: Hardware fit accepted; spring compliance needs revision.

pump.fit: Derek reports the pump snap and base fit are very good; retain them.
pump.spring: Only complaint is leaf bending concentrated at the corners; use an intermediate thickness.
pump.status: Hardware fit accepted; spring compliance needs revision.

meter.receiver: Derek reports a very good fit, including room for the wire. Preserve the receiver hardware cavity.
meter.cap: Does not clamp tightly enough. Add central thickness and shape to bear on the housing in more directions.
meter.status: Receiver fit accepted; cap bearing and spring compliance need revision.

regulator.receiver: Large visible gaps with hardware shifted to either side; investigate scan/model/printed cavity relation.
regulator.cap: Does not clamp tightly enough. Add central thickness and shape to secure the hardware in more directions.
regulator.status: Receiver fit, cap bearing and spring compliance need revision.

requested_leaf_revision.scope: Intermediate thickness and root transition under review; not a selected production revision or new print launch.
